subject: Hands-on POC & environment preflight — scheduling + reschedule
messages:
From: Lisa Vernon <lisa@acme-logistics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Hands-on POC & environment preflight for Redwood inference

Connor —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our product team (Raj and I) want to move to a hands-on POC next week to exercise routing, prompt variations, and a short load test against a staging endpoint. Security will need a quick preflight before we can allow any connectivity.

High level asks:
- Can we schedule a 90-minute interactive session (prompt review + routing diagnostics + 15m load test)?
- Security needs an allowlist + guidance on KMS and API key scoping.
- Prefer mornings PT (9–11am) on Tue/Wed/Thu next week.

Participants from our side: Lisa Vernon (PM), Raj Patel (SRE), Acme DevOps (devops@acme-logistics.com).

Thanks — please send a checklist we can run in parallel with your scheduling.

—Lisa
Lisa Vernon
Product Manager, Acme Logistics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Vernon <lisa@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on POC & environment preflight for Redwood inference

Lisa — thanks, excited to run this with you. We can do a 90-minute hands-on session and will include:
- Prompt review and prompt-set sanity checks
- Routing walk-through (model variants, fallback rules)
- Live KV-prefix caching demo and a 15-minute controlled load test

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-04 09:30–11:00
- Wed 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-08-06 09:00–10:30

Preflight checklist (short):
1) Sandbox account email(s) for staging: please send the service account or user emails we'll allow.
2) API key: create a scoped API key named "acme-poc-readgen" (we'll provide exact scopes).
3) IP ranges for allowlist (if not using VPC peering).
4) KMS key ARN (if you require customer-managed keys) or indicate if Redwood-managed KMS is OK for this POC.
5) Sample prompt set (5–10 prompts) you want to validate during the session.
6) Any egress firewall/NAT gateway details for load test window.

I've attached a short preflight CSV and a runbook stub (acme_preflight_checklist.csv, acme_runbook_stub.pdf) and a network-diagram.png to assist security.

If none of the times work, let me know a preferred window and we'll adapt. After we confirm the slot I'll send a calendar invite with the session agenda and test window for the load test.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
Attach: acme_preflight_checklist.csv, acme_runbook_stub.pdf, network-diagram.png

From: Acme DevOps <devops@acme-logistics.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -0700

Connor/Lisa —

Quick answers from security/devops:
- We'll provide service account names: svc-acme-poc@acme-logistics.com, svc-acme-load@acme-logistics.com.
- IP ranges for allowlist (we prefer allowlist over VPC peering for the POC): 54.210.32.0/24, 54.210.33.0/24.
- KMS: we must use our own KMS key (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345).

Regarding schedule: Wednesday 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30 PT conflicts with a planned patch window on our side. Can we move to Thu 2026-08-06 09:00–10:30 PT? If not possible, propose Fri 2026-08-07 10:30–12:00 PT.

Also: we need the TLS certificate subject name you will connect to for any allowlist/VPN configuration so we can validate during setup.

—Acme DevOps

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Acme DevOps <devops@acme-logistics.com>, Lisa Vernon <lisa@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on POC & environment preflight for Redwood inference

Thanks for the details — appreciate the quick turnaround. Thu 2026-08-06 09:00–10:30 PT works for our team. I've locked that slot and sent a calendar invite; please accept when you can.

TLS / certificate info: the endpoint you'll see for the POC is staging.redwood-inference.com (subject CN=staging.redwood-inference.com). We'll serve a certificate from a public CA; you do not need to upload certificates on your side for the allowlist step. For VPC peering or VPN please let me know and we'll provide a separate peering guide.

API key / KMS steps (actionable):
- Create two service accounts: svc-acme-poc@acme-logistics.com and svc-acme-load@acme-logistics.com.
- Create scoped API key name: acme-poc-readgen (scopes: generate:text, embeddings:read).
- For KMS, add the Redwood service principal (kms-access@redwood-inference.com) to your key policy with Encrypt/Decrypt permissions for this key ARN. We'll use the key only for logging-at-rest in the POC; secrets stay on your account.

Load test plan: we'll do a 15-minute stepped load test starting at 10:00 PT (runbook attached). Please ensure NAT egress bandwidth is sufficient for ~100 concurrent short requests.

I've uploaded an updated network-diagram.png and the runbook to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AcmeRunbookStub. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/8842. DocuSign (if Proc needs approval): https://www.docusign.com/en/rdw-8842.

Attachments referenced: acme_preflight_checklist.csv, acme_runbook_stub.pdf, network-diagram.png

See you Thu 08/06 at 09:00 PT — I'll circulate a final agenda and the prompt set we plan to validate.

—Connor

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Vernon <lisa@acme-logistics.com>, Acme DevOps <devops@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hands-on POC & environment preflight — internal sync and load-test ops note

Marissa / Lauren — internal note before the session:

- We'll run the prompt review first (15–20m) using the prompts Lisa shared; objective: spot any prompt hallucination patterns and tune stop sequences.
- Routing demo + KV-prefix cache demo (25–30m). Marissa, can you bring the canary routing snippet and the metrics dashboard link?
- Controlled stepped load test 10:00–10:15 PT — aim for 25 -> 50 -> 100 concurrent short requests. Monitor token-cost and tail latency.
- If Acme's NAT egress shows throttling, we'll switch to a reduced concurrency fallback and capture traces.

I'll be on the call with my laptop sharing the runbook and the network diagram. Lauren, please have the rollback policy and fallback model (smaller quantized variant) ready in case we need to reduce load mid-test.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
